purpose: Resolve historical starter/tie/DNF target semantics before any Job004 fit. No performance information used.

historical_model_universe.starter_classifier_authority: reuse existing audited src.audit.p2_m07_target_universe.starter_status semantics; do not create a new result-status vocabulary
historical_model_universe.nonstarter_rule: resolved nonstarter/cancellation/exclusion rows remain in Job003 canonical feature artifacts but are excluded from Job004 target rows and all historical PL probability universes

effective_rank.n_r: number of actual starters in the race after audited starter_status classification

valid_finisher_rule.rank_validation: finish_position must be an integer in [1,n_r]
valid_finisher_rule.tie_validation: competition-ranking sequence. For sorted distinct official ranks r_g with group sizes t_g: first r_1=1; next r_(g+1)=r_g+t_g. Duplicates are therefore allowed only as an official tie group.

no_valid_finish_rule.interpretation: right-censored at the bottom: known to be outside every valid finisher, with no ordering asserted inside the non-finisher group

effective_rank.rank_mass_invariant: sum(r_eff over actual starters) == n_r*(n_r+1)/2 within 1e-12
effective_rank.no_imputation_claim: Tie midrank and bottom-censored midrank are deterministic encodings of known partial order; they do not fabricate an internal ordering.

top3_integrity.required: exactly 3 distinct official Top3 horse numbers per accepted race
top3_integrity.ambiguous_top3: BLOCK; do not resolve with horse number, time, popularity, payout, or arbitrary tie-breaking

job003_starter_semantics_audit.reason: Job003 canonical artifacts contain retained nonstarter rows; support counts and race-composition aggregates must not silently treat them as starters.
job003_starter_semantics_audit.start_definition: count historical rows classified STARTER_VALID_FINISH or STARTER_NO_VALID_FINISH only; source_race_date < target_race_date
job003_starter_semantics_audit.race_composition_rule: recompute every P1_RACE_COMPOSITION aggregate from actual-starter rows only and compare to stored Job003 values using the frozen formula and NaN semantics
job003_starter_semantics_audit.if_mismatch: JOB004_BLOCKED_JOB003_STARTER_SEMANTICS; do not fit. Report exact affected features/races and rematerialize only under a new authorized Job003 amendment.

runtime_preflight.rule_if_all_present: freeze executable path, Python version, package versions, platform, and relevant package file hashes in RUNTIME_FREEZE_V1.json before first fit
runtime_preflight.rule_if_missing: JOB004A_RUNTIME_BLOCKED; do not pip install and do not substitute another ML/optimizer implementation
